name: cGAS–STING innate sensing
author: Jude Gomila
message: Editing pass: every TL;DR and summary stands alone

fields.before: "The cell's alarm for DNA in the wrong place. Radiation, chemotherapy, and ADCs spill DNA into the cytoplasm; cGAS detects it, STING sounds the alarm, and interferon calls in the immune system."
fields.after: "cGAS-STING is the cell's alarm for DNA in the wrong place. Radiation, chemotherapy, and ADCs spill DNA into the cytoplasm; cGAS detects it, STING sounds the alarm, and interferon calls in the immune system."
